title: Zesty Slow Uruguayan Pasta
description: A hearty and flavorful Whole30-friendly dish featuring bowtie pasta, slow-cooked to perfection with grassy and silky textures, perfect for curing hangovers. This Uruguayan-inspired recipe is a twist on traditional pasta dishes.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the grass-fed ground beef, if using, and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the tomato paste, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the bowtie pasta, stirring to combine with the meat and vegetable mixture.
Add 4 cups of water to the Dutch oven, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes, or until the pasta is al dente.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
